preconditions.description: The number of characters n is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of known relationships m is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i and c_i in {0, 1} for a_i, b_i, c_i in relationships)
preconditions.description: Each relationship is defined by two distinct characters between 1 and n, and a love/hate status of 0 or 1.
The number of relationships provided matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000,007.
The output is the number of ways to fill in the remaining relationships so that every triangle is happy, modulo 1,000,000,007.
